احتجزتم (form VIII)
# اِحْتَجَزْتُمْ (iḥtajaztum) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒaz.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# اُحْتُجِزْتُمْ (uḥtujiztum) /uħ.tu.d͡ʒiz.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
